part5_ref: CA 5 — DCC Cannabis Unified License Search (the API behind it, resolved from the app's own config.js)
note: California's entire DCC licence universe: 20,984 records across the 7 statuses (Active 7,527; Expired 9,141; Surrendered 2,151; Canceled 1,622; Revoked 340; Limited Operations 156; Suspended 47). data.ca.gov carries NO DCC licence dataset, and the DCC publishes no bulk file, so this API — named in search.cannabis.ca.gov's own config.js as CANNA_API — is the official source. The host is an azurewebsites.net name rather than a .ca.gov one; it is official by virtue of being the DCC app's declared backend, not by its hostname. Carries premiseCounty, owner names, coordinates, licensing authority and the Adult-Use/Medicinal designation. Requires at least one search criterion, hence iterating the status list; the totals are summed and checked.
